title: Squares on a Chessboard
summary: Count each size separately and add them up.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: A chessboard has 8 by 8 small squares.
How many squares of any size can you find?
points: A chessboard has 8 by 8 small squares.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Do not just count the 64 small ones. Bigger squares made of several small ones count too.
points: Do not just count the 64 small ones. Bigger squares made of several small ones count too.

steps.title: The method: Count by size
sentences: 3 by 3 squares: 6 times 6 is 36, and so on down to 1 big square.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: 64 plus 49 plus 36 plus 25 plus 16 plus 9 plus 4 plus 1 is 204.
The pattern is the sum of the squares 1 to 8.
points: 64 plus 49 plus 36 plus 25 plus 16 plus 9 plus 4 plus 1 is 204.

quiz.q: How many squares of any size are on a 3 by 3 grid?
